title: Etale at a prime iff flat and unramified at that prime (finitely presented)
statement: Let R\to S be a ring map making S a finitely presented R-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], let q be a prime of S and p=q\cap R. The following are equivalent: (1) Algebra.IsEtaleAt R q, that is, the localization S_q [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is formally etale over R; (2) there is g\in S\setminus q such that \operatorname{Spec}S_g\to\operatorname{Spec}R is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]; (3) S_q is flat over R_p [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and the localization (\Omega_{S/R})_q of the module of Kahler differentials [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is zero.
